excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: For the CL to sync, it needs access to all of the transaction receipts (and I think block headers too, maybe bodies, I'm not sure) since the deposit contract went live.

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: This means that execution clients cannot prune that data, and it is a non-trivial volume of data.
